purpose: Separate the verified revised PEP series design from documented classroom/platform rollout. Rollout evidence is locality/province specific unless a national mathematics-specific source states otherwise.

national_publisher_context.claim: PEP states that the 12th series began formal use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
national_publisher_context.limit: Does not provide a mathematics-specific national grade-by-grade rollout schedule.

documented_rollout_examples.evidence: Municipal education platform records 数学人教版（新课标）一年级上册（2024年新编）.
Municipal platform records 数学人教版（新课标）一年级下册（2025年新编）.
Municipal platform records 数学人教版（新课标）二年级上册（2025年新编） and 三年级上册（2025年新编）.
Municipal platform records revised PEP Grade 2 lower and Grade 3 lower mathematics directories as new/updated for the term.

An official education notice states that 2026 primary mathematics revised-textbook training covers Grades 4-6 and that publishers supplied Grades 4-6 upper-semester textbook samples for training. The underlying provincial notice covers PEP and Jiangsu Education versions; local Wuwei implementation uses Jiangsu Education, so this evidence establishes the provincial rollout/training structure but is not itself proof that every locality uses PEP.
documented_rollout_examples.pep_use_limit: Use only to explain the 2026 Grade 4-6 rollout/training phase in Anhui. Do not state that Wuwei itself uses PEP mathematics.

interpretation.verified: The revised PEP series sequence contains all 12 designed volumes. In documented PEP-use contexts, active classroom/platform evidence progresses by term rather than all 12 books appearing simultaneously in 2024.
interpretation.strong_inference: The scarcity of genuine revised Grade 4-6 lower-semester classroom resources by August 2026 is consistent with the documented rollout, because Grade 4-6 upper books are entering the 2026 autumn training/use phase in the cited Anhui evidence.
interpretation.not_verified: A nationwide mathematics-specific rule that every PEP-using locality follows exactly the same grade/term schedule, or an official national statement that Grade 4-6 lower revised PEP begins spring 2027.

product_rules: Series sequence may show a future/designed PEP volume even when local classroom rollout has not reached that semester.
When the user asks what a Chinese class is currently using, require locality/publisher/term context; do not infer from the series design alone.
Do not describe PEP as the national textbook; it is a major approved textbook series used in selected localities.
Do not use the three-subject unified-textbook rollout schedule as mathematics rollout evidence.
